# Rojesh Man Shikhrakar

> AI trainer, AI expert and educator based in Kathmandu, Nepal. Director of AI Education & Talent Development at Fusemachines (since 2017), visiting faculty in machine learning at Kathmandu University, and Senior AI Consultant with Nepal Speakers Bureau. Has trained 1,500+ AI engineers across 15+ countries through the Fusemachines AI Fellowship, and delivers corporate, enterprise, government and NGO AI training across Nepal.

Also known as: Rojesh Shikhrakar. Location: Kathmandu, Nepal. Contact: mail@rojeshshikhrakar.com.np. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/rojeshshikhrakar/

Topics: generative AI and ChatGPT/Claude for work, prompt engineering, AI productivity, AI strategy for leaders, AI governance and responsible AI, machine learning and deep learning for engineers, AI in higher education. Delivery: in-person in Kathmandu and across Nepal, or online for international teams.

## AI training in Nepal

- [AI Trainer in Nepal](https://rojeshshikhrakar.com.np/ai-trainer-nepal): Overview of AI training for organizations and professionals in Nepal
- [Corporate AI Training in Nepal](https://rojeshshikhrakar.com.np/corporate-ai-training-nepal): Generative AI in real team workflows
- [Enterprise AI Training in Nepal](https://rojeshshikhrakar.com.np/enterprise-ai-training-nepal): Readiness, strategy, adoption and governance
- [AI Productivity Training in Nepal](https://rojeshshikhrakar.com.np/ai-productivity-training-nepal): Repeatable AI workflows for research, writing and analysis
- [AI Governance Training in Nepal](https://rojeshshikhrakar.com.np/ai-governance-training-nepal): Responsible use, privacy, risk and oversight
- [AI Training for Government & NGOs in Nepal](https://rojeshshikhrakar.com.np/ai-training-government-ngos-nepal): Mission-aligned AI adoption for public and development organizations
- [Workshop catalogue](https://rojeshshikhrakar.com.np/workshops): ChatGPT, Claude, Google AI, AI for research and institutional AI strategy workshops
